title: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: Full lifecycle orchestration: intake (GitHub/Linear) -> execution (isolated K8s) -> PR monitoring -> auto-resume on CI failure/review comments -> auto-merge.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
summary: Microsoft/GitHub open-sourced APM to manage agent dependencies (skills, prompts, MCP) with lockfiles (apm.lock) for reproducibility across developers and CI. Includes 'apm audit' for supply-chain security.

title: G0 – The control layer for AI agents
summary: Unified security/governance tool for agents (LangChain, CrewAI, MCP). Probes for OpenClaw-specific vulnerabilities (ClawHavoc malware) and maps findings to compliance standards like OWASP and NIST.

title: Stripe: 1,000+ AI-merged PRs per week
summary: Stripe reports that internal AI coding agents are autonomously generating and merging over 1,000 pull requests per week for routine engineering work.
